referenceUse: Local reference art was visually inspected for art direction. Final assets were generated independently from text prompts.
notes: Seven independently generated product masters. Existing product_cup_fill.png is loose popcorn only and does not replace a complete packaged original cup. Source alpha is preserved; no programmatic drawing or background replacement was used.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one standalone 2.5D mobile factory game inventory sprite, high-resolution transparent PNG master.
Style: polished hand-painted 3D-like game asset, same family as clean teal isometric factory machinery and warm popcorn sprites. Orthographic three-quarter view, camera about 30 degrees above the subject; soft upper-left light, restrained highlights, clean thick readable silhouette, simplified large forms and a few crisp material details. Not photography, not flat vector art. Legible when reduced to 64 pixels.
Composition: exactly ONE complete product centered on a square canvas, entirely visible, taking about 80 percent of canvas height, with clear breathing room. No other objects, no pedestal, no table, no floor, no detached cast shadow, no background scene.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA alpha, including all empty pixels around the object; not a white background or a painted checkerboard. No text, numbers, letters, labels, logos, watermarks or UI.

Subject: A complete tapered red-and-white vertically striped paper cup, narrower at the bottom, white rolled rim, heaped with irregular pale creamy popcorn above its mouth. The popcorn kernels are clearly irregular popped corn with warm golden creases, not perfectly round balls. The cup and striped packaging occupy at least half the product silhouette. No lid. Preserve a distinctive tall cup silhouette. Red stripes are broad and simple, with no branding.
assets.description: Red-white striped original popcorn cup with visible cream popcorn.

Subject: One thick FIVE-POINTED STAR confection made from tightly joined caramel popcorn kernels on a SHORT wooden stick. The star has a chunky uneven granular popcorn texture and visible individual popped-corn lobes, never a smooth candy slab or cookie. Preserve exactly five clear star points and show a little thickness along its side. The golden-amber star and upper stick are wrapped inside one fitted transparent cellophane bag, whose delicate outline and a few white folds are visible while the star stays easy to read. Subject: One premium rigid rectangular celebration gift box, deep teal outer cardboard with restrained cream and golden-yellow trim, broad transparent FRONT display window, a clearly visible sturdy top carrying handle, and structured inner compartment dividers. The box is closed and finished, shown as a complete portable gift package. Through the large clear window the contents are clearly recognizable and countable: exactly ONE wide divided popcorn bucket at lower left with amber caramel on its left and yellow cheese on its right; exactly ONE clear dark-sleeved chocolate popcorn cup at lower right with white zigzag drizzle on the dark popcorn; exactly TWO thick five-point caramel popcorn stars on short sticks in their own upper or back compartments. All four packaged components sit inside the same box, none outside. Keep shapes large and simplified so the box reads as the combination of these products at small size. Subtle tiny star symbol permitted on one corner, no decorative clutter, no bow that hides the handle or window.

Additional exact product packaging requirements: the lower-left duo bucket is a ROUND bucket with a smooth white round rim and a visible WHITE CENTRAL DIVIDER, with teal left wall and amber right wall; no scalloped or square carton. The lower-right chocolate cup has a plain CHARCOAL PAPER SLEEVE edged in thin cream, with no symbol on the sleeve, and visible crossing white drizzle on the chocolate popcorn. Each of the TWO upper star popcorn pops is individually wrapped in clear cellophane with a small teal tie and a short stick. Exactly one unified box containing those four distinct products. The background is empty alpha transparency; DO NOT illustrate transparency as squares or checks. Export genuine transparent PNG with alpha=0 surrounding the sprite and through the handle opening.
assets.description: Handled window gift box containing one duo bucket, one chocolate cup and two star pops.

giftIterationHistory.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: one standalone 2.5D mobile factory game gift-box sprite, transparent PNG.
Input images: Image 1 is the gift-box edit target. Image 2 is the exact visual reference for the divided duo bucket. Image 3 is the exact visual reference for the chocolate popcorn cup. Image 4 is the exact visual reference for the bagged star popcorn pop.
Change only the PACKAGED CONTENTS visible through the large front window in Image 1 so their packaging matches images 2-4. Preserve the outer teal gift-box silhouette, carrying handle, transparent front display window, four compartments, camera, shading, trim, composition and exact content count.
Lower left: exactly one duo bucket matching image 2, with smooth round white rim, teal LEFT wall and amber RIGHT wall, clearly visible white central divider separating glossy caramel on LEFT from golden cheese on RIGHT. Do not use scalloped striped carton packaging.
Lower right: exactly one transparent chocolate popcorn cup matching image 3, with simple charcoal paper sleeve and thin cream edges, NO star emblem or other decoration on the sleeve; dark chocolate popcorn has clearly crossing white-chocolate drizzle lines.
Top: exactly two five-point caramel popcorn stars on short wooden sticks, matching image 4. Both retain popcorn-kernel texture and each has a fitted CLEAR CELLOPHANE BAG with subtle white folds and a small teal tie around its short wooden stick. The bag should not obscure the five-point star silhouette.
Preserve one bucket, one cup and TWO star pops, all inside the box. No additional products. Keep all details large and readable at 64-pixel game size. No text or numbers. Preserve genuinely transparent RGBA background outside the entire box and through the handle hole, never a painted checkerboard, never white backdrop, no floor or cast shadow.
giftIterationHistory.reason: Rejected: baked checkerboard background with alpha 255.

giftIterationHistory.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Edit target: the attached finished teal popcorn gift-box sprite.
Make the background genuinely TRANSPARENT with an RGBA alpha channel. Remove every gray checkerboard tile outside the gift box and inside the opening of the top carrying handle. These checkerboard squares are unwanted background pixels, not part of the artwork. All removed background pixels must have alpha 0; do not replace the pattern with white, black, gray, another pattern, a floor or a shadow.
Preserve the exact gift-box artwork unchanged: outer silhouette, teal cardboard, gold and cream trim, handle, clear front window, inner dividers, one caramel-and-cheese divided bucket at lower left, one chocolate cup with white crisscross drizzle and dark paper sleeve at lower right, and exactly two separately bagged star-shaped popcorn pops above. Preserve the transparent-cellophane reflections and every product detail inside the box. No text, no added objects, no recoloring. Return a clean isolated transparent PNG sprite.
giftIterationHistory.reason: Rejected: baked checkerboard persisted with alpha 255.
